name: The Stein Collection
summary: This is a rim sherd from a 1600s' porcelain bowl with unrecognisable underglaze cobalt blue and iron-red decoration. This sherd along with many other pottery sherds was found at the site of Suoyangcheng. Souyangcheng lies ca. 50 km east of Dunhuang, Gansu Province.  It is the site of a military town
